s1.desc: a living room with a long cream couch, drawn on a plain pale grey background

spans.notes: tracking shot following Polly as she carries the snacks past the door; the background slides and the picture rocks a few degrees with each step
fast pull-back to the wide view of the couch; f46 is the first locked frame (46->47 identity)

beats.text: Polly stands beside the couch holding an armful of snacks and a blanket while Pax lies asleep on his back
Polly lets the whole pile drop to the floor
Polly stands still, staring at the sleeping Pax
Polly leans toward the couch and reaches a flipper out to Pax while he keeps sleeping with a flipper dangling

spans.notes: 23 frames between the pull-back (ends f45) and a short pan (starts f69); compare 46/68: couch edges black, global estimate identity
quick 5-frame reframe: the couch slides ~95 px (at 1080 wide) to the right

beats.text: Polly reaches over the end of the couch toward the sleeping Pax
Polly clambers onto the couch and sprawls on her belly across Pax, kicking her feet
Polly sits up on the couch against Pax and presses her flippers to his face while he stays asleep

spans.notes: 28 frames; compare 74/101: couch edges black, global estimate identity (73->74 still moving, 74->75 identity)
closer two-shot on the couch, Polly hugging and shaking the sleeping Pax; slow push-in with a reframe (scale +4% by f120, couch edges doubled in compare 102/151 and 128/151)

close-up of Polly wailing with flippers flung wide, Pax's head at the left edge; the picture drifts and pulls back slowly (scale -3% over f168-185, the blurred foreground couch arm doubles in compare 166/185)
